g.text: APP DB (spectracsPy.db) + SERVER DB (spectracsPyServer.db) · SQLite via SQLAlchemy
pluginVersion : String ' A3 provenance: exact resolved version; NULL = shipped built-in
username : String ' soft ref -> AppUser (stamped at Save)
userId : String ' soft ref (the Home list FILTER key)
type : String ' ACQUISITION | PROCESSING | EVALUATION | METADATA | PUBLISHING
role : String ' REFERENCE | SAMPLE | ABSORPTION | TRANSMISSION (bag key)
valuesJson : String ' the {nm:value} map, via Spectrum.toJson()/fromJson()
resultJson : String ' view-models via EvaluationResult.toJson() (VerdictView: roastState+hueDegrees)
name : String ' field key; pumpkin: title | temperature | dateOfRoasting
showInWorkflowsTable : Boolean ' plugin-declared; true -> a Home-list column (pumpkin: title only)
spectrometerDevice : String ' stable device code-name, e.g. "Virtuax"
PLANNED (SPEC_workflow_persistence.md, Option A / concept §9.5). The workflow IS the record:
the runtime model/spectral classes ARE the app-DB entities (one class = runtime object + DB row).
Leaf maps are JSON columns ON their entity: Spectrum.valuesJson = Spectrum.toJson();
EvaluationResult.resultJson = EvaluationResult.toJson(). No separate Db* twins.
Cleanup: the dead DbSpectrum + MeasurementProfile stubs are DELETED.
view / widget (Step), captured burst (Spectrum) = transient, NOT mapped.
Metadata: plugin-declared generic (EAV) rows; relationship = metadataFields
) = owned: deleting the parent deletes the child.
